December 12, 2024: Mr. David Jones, a 31-year-old male, presented today for a follow-up regarding his Multiple sclerosis. He reports that he has been adhering to his treatment regimen with natalizumab 300 mg IV and dimethyl fumarate 240 mg. His neurological examination remains stable, and he continues to function well with an EDSS score of 2. His blood pressure was 113/68, and he weighed 143 pounds. Mr. Jones continues to engage in regular physical activity, running 3-4 times per week. He has a history of smoking cigarettes, but he quit in January 2021, and his tobacco was limited to one pack per day before cessation.
